source.note: Kenney train-electric-bullet-a (the front/cab car; the kit also has train-electric-bullet-b and -c, the middle and rear cars, not shipped here). FBX member plus its colormap texture, flattened to 20 colours. Stylized proportions: at a real shinkansen height (3.7 m above the rail) it is 6.32 m long and 2.98 m wide (a real end car is ~25-27 m by 3.38 m). Static, no clips.
